lifecycleEvidence.evidence: Current official sDOLA product guide documents permissionless mainnet minting and unwrapping. Smart-contract registry updated for October 2026 lists this exact mainnet sDOLA token; retired CCIP lanes and L2 receipts are explicitly separate historical deployments, not retirement of mainnet sDOLA. No mainnet vault shutdown notice encountered in reviewed official sources.

deploymentEvidence.proxyType: none in reviewed direct sDola source

semantics: Direct sDola inherits the deployed Solmate ERC4626 and ERC20 implementation, not a generic replacement ABI. All four entry/exit functions are inherited and their afterDeposit/beforeWithdraw hooks bind the DolaSavings stake/unstake workflow.

Deposits are never redeployed to borrowers by this wrapper: afterDeposit stakes into DolaSavings; DOLA revenue from buyDBR is added to weeklyRevenue and released linearly over the following week. No lock-up or user claim function.
beforeWithdraw requires totalAssets >= assets + 10**16 and totalSupply - shares >= 10**18; inherited maxWithdraw/maxRedeem omit these residual constraints.

Governance can reconfigure auction operator/K/governance and sweep assets other than DBR. Permissionless reapprove affects protocol allowance; buyDBR has a source-level UI warning; neither is a savings user action.

activityEvidence.evidence: Explorer indexed deposit on 2026-10-17 and withdrawal on 2026-10-22 support observed activity, not unique users/DAU, vault TVL, current RPC execution or maintenance guarantee.

selectedFunctions.label: Inverse Finance sDOLA deposit
warnings: Ethereum mainnet sDOLA only. Official docs explicitly shut down sDOLA CCIP lanes in August 2026; historical L2 tokens and all bridge functions are outside this integration.

Underlying is DOLA (0x865377367054516e17014ccded1e7d814edc9ce4), not USDC. Deposits/mints transfer caller DOLA using allowance and stake it in the fixed savings contract; withdrawals/redeems unstake and return DOLA to the chosen receiver. Delegated exits require owner share allowance.

No caller-set minimum shares/maximum assets/deadline. ERC4626 rounding, weekly revenue vesting, DOLA depeg, smart-contract and fluctuating yield risks apply. totalAssets is capped at 10**32; withdrawing must leave at least 10**16 DOLA accounting units and 10**18 total shares. maxWithdraw/maxRedeem do not subtract these residual minima and are not an execution guarantee.

No user cooldown or separate reward claim. Yield comes from DBR auctions and vests over the following week; direct buyDBR and protocol allowance maintenance are not admitted. Source warns against treating sDOLA as a borrowable asset in systems sensitive to atomic value jumps.

Deployment/ABI/source matching evidence, not a fresh runtime/RPC identity, balance, liquidity or successful-execution guarantee. All admitted calls are nonpayable with zero native value. Independent authorization, token approvals, pause and signing controls remain required.
